observations: Single photo shows a hand holding a black DSLR camera body with a lens attached, in front of a wall with a light switch.
The camera body has 'Nikon' text visible on the pentaprism area (photo 0).
The model designation (e.g. 'D810') is not legible in the photo; the front dial/screen is too small/angled to read.

A lens is mounted on the body; the lens barrel text and focal length markings are not clearly legible, lens cap is on, so front element and branding on the lens itself (e.g. Nikon vs third-party) cannot be confirmed.
No shots of the camera's rear screen, shutter count, serial number, top LCD, card slot, ports, or accessories (battery, charger, box) are provided.
No image of the lens from the side/top showing its printed specs (e.g. '24-70mm').

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'Nikon' branding but the D810 model marking is not legible in the image.
A lens is mounted in photo 0 but its printed focal length and brand are not readable; could be Nikon or third-party.
Single low-detail photo does not show sensor, LCD, body wear, or functional state.

risks.risk: Camera model may not actually be a D810 (could be a cheaper/older Nikon body) since model text is unreadable.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the top-plate model badge or the camera's info/menu screen showing model name.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/base Nikon DSLR body, not the higher-value D810

risks.risk: Lens could be a lower-value third-party or kit lens rather than a genuine Nikon 24-70mm.
risks.proof: Close-up of the lens barrel showing brand name and focal length/aperture printing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified generic zoom lens, not a premium 24-70mm

risks.risk: Shutter count / mechanical wear unknown, common issue in used high-end DSLRs.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data of a recent test shot.

risks.risk: Functional state (autofocus, sensor dust/fungus, dead pixels) unverified.
risks.proof: Video clip of camera powering on, taking a shot, and displaying image on LCD, plus a photo of a blank wall/sky for sensor dust check.

risks.risk: Completeness of sale (battery, charger, memory card, box) unclear from listing text and single photo.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body + lens only, no accessories

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the camera's model badge/top plate or menu screen clearly showing 'D810'.
Close-up photo of the lens barrel showing brand and focal length/aperture text.
Photo or video of the camera powered on, showing the rear LCD and a live or captured image.
Shutter count screenshot from camera menu or recent EXIF data.
Photo of all accessories included in the sale (battery, charger, cap, card, box).
response.reason: The core price-determining facts — whether the body is truly a D810 and whether the lens is a genuine Nikon 24-70mm — are both illegible in the single provided photo, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without confirming at least the model and lens identity.
